timing: Before V sees any new function acceptance results; I/A reported constructor side effects during implementation review. This adds explicit filesystem/schema counterexamples without editing the frozen base.

counterexamples.input: Nonexistent workspace/pool path passed to status/progress
counterexamples.pass: Return explicit missing/error/empty status according to API; parent directory, database and sidecar remain absent
counterexamples.fail: Any constructor creates directories, empty database, log, runtime job or budget state during a query

counterexamples.input: Valid legacy pool schema which writable open would migrate/index
counterexamples.pass: Read using read-only compatible path, or clearly reject unsupported schema without mutation; old source DB and schema/index definitions unchanged
counterexamples.fail: DDL/index/schema migration, history repair or implicit data normalization on status/progress read

counterexamples.input: Existing pending/unknown pool with committed events and reservations
counterexamples.pass: Before/after logical rows, schema/index, event prefix, jobs and budget equal; no new dispatch or settlement
counterexamples.fail: Plain status/progress starts work, emits synthetic events, refunds unknown reserve or changes ledger

evidence: Record baseline directory listing/DB schema/index/rows and final comparison
Use real store/query functions; do not mock constructor or SQLite write behavior
Instrument dispatch to detect unintended work; mocks may guard forbidden side effects but cannot replace query itself
